title: Pure Ashened
summary: Ashened cards and the Veidos cards they revolve around, with generic staples and Pyro Rank 4s. Every Ashened monster Special Summons itself from the hand while Obsidim, the Ashened City is in the Field Zone, while Veidos jumps to the opponent's field to blow up Obsidim and wipe the board.

summary.title: Starters
points: Awakening of Veidos places Obsidim, the Ashened City from the Deck into either Field Zone as a Quick-Play, and if the opponent controls a card in their Field Zone, adds a Level 5+ DARK Pyro (Veidos, Hero or King) from your Deck to your hand.
Priestess of the Ashened City Special Summons itself while Obsidim is on the field and searches any Ashened card on Normal or Special Summon.

Veidos the Eruption Dragon of Extinction Special Summons itself to the opponent's field as a Quick Effect by destroying a card in a Field Zone, then adds or Sets an Ashened Continuous Trap (Ashened for Eternity or Ashened to Endlessness) from your Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Awakening of Veidos or Priestess + Obsidim
steps: Activate Awakening of Veidos to place Obsidim, the Ashened City in the opponent's Field Zone and search Veidos the Eruption Dragon of Extinction (or Priestess of the Ashened City).
Special Summon Priestess of the Ashened City from the hand (enabled by Obsidim) to search Hero of the Ashened City or Extinguishing the Ashened.
Special Summon Veidos to the opponent's field by destroying Obsidim in their Field Zone, setting Ashened to Endlessness or Ashened for Eternity from the Deck.

Destroyed Obsidim triggers in the GY to Special Summon an Ashened monster from the Deck; on the opponent's turn, fuse Veidos away with Ashened to Endlessness or destroy it with Hero of the Ashened City to trigger Veidos's board-wide monster wipe.

summary.title: Veidos Nuke & Pyro Conversion
summary.text: Whenever Veidos the Eruption Dragon of Extinction is sent from the opponent's field to your GY—whether destroyed by Hero of the Ashened City, reclaimed and linked off via Ashened for Eternity, or used as Fusion Material across both fields via Ashened to Endlessness—it triggers to destroy all monsters on the field. Meanwhile, Obsidim, the Ashened City and Ashened to Endlessness turn the opponent's monsters into Pyro-Type, letting you fuse away their board for Veidos the Dragon of Endless Darkness or Embers of the Ashened.

summary.title: Fusion & Xyz Payoff
points: Veidos the Dragon of Endless Darkness (Veidos + 2+ Level 9 or lower Pyro monsters) cannot be destroyed by card effects, cannot be targeted by monster effects, wipes all opposing Spells and Traps on Fusion Summon, and sends an Ashened card you control to the GY as a Quick Effect to destroy any card the opponent activates.

Embers of the Ashened (2 Pyro monsters) recovers Obsidim or an Ashened Field Spell from the GY on Fusion Summon, destroys any Pyro monster it battles at the start of the Damage Step, and makes a second attack.
Infernal Flame Banshee (Rank 4 from Priestess and Spearhead) detaches a material to search or mill any Pyro monster, finding Veidos directly.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Inferno of the Ashened is not yet released in the TCG.

exclude.Inferno of the Ashened: Not released in the TCG yet.

main: Priestess of the Ashened City
Starter: summons itself under Obsidim and searches an Ashened card.
Veidos the Eruption Dragon of Extinction
Jumps to their field to destroy a Field Spell and fetch an Ashened Continuous Trap; wipes the monsters when it comes back.
Hero of the Ashened City
Destroys a Pyro on either Main Phase; destroying Veidos places Obsidim.
King of the Ashened City
Summons an Ashened from the hand, or from the Deck against a 2800-ATK monster.
Shaman of the Ashened City
Shuffles three Pyro back to search Obsidim.
Spearhead of the Ashened City
Tributes itself to bounce a card when they have a 2800-ATK monster.
Obsidim, the Ashened City
Field Spell: turns their Special Summoned monsters Pyro on your turn; replaces itself from the Deck.
Awakening of Veidos
Quick-Play: places Obsidim from the Deck; searches Veidos if they have a Field Spell.
Extinguishing the Ashened
Mills a DARK Pyro and recovers a big Pyro; Fusion Summons from the GY.
Rekindling the Ashened
Quick-Play: recycles an Ashened card to negate a monster.
Ashened for Eternity
Takes Veidos back from their field; recovers Veidos or an Ashened when activated.
Ashened to Endlessness
Fuses Veidos with monsters from either field; turns their monsters Pyro.
extra: Fusion from two Pyro: recovers Obsidim; destroys a Pyro it battles and attacks again.
Veidos the Dragon of Endless Darkness
Fusion boss: wipes their Spells/Traps and destroys a card on activation.
Pyro Rank 4: searches or mills a Pyro.
Rank 4 from two Pyro: banishes three GY monsters when destroyed.
